I'll start by reading the execution file and the referenced documents.
Now I'll implement `src/cli/format.ts`.
Now I'll add the focused tests.
Implemented TTY-aware, accessible human output with a shared formatter and routed `list`, `status`, and `config` through it.

## Changed files

**Created**
- `src/cli/format.ts` — colour detection (`isTTY`, `NO_COLOR`, `TERM=dumb`), text status labels with optional colour, 80-column field/table rendering, column shrinking/dropping, and detail lines for values that do not fit.
- `tests/unit/format.test.ts` — 19 tests covering forced TTY, forced non-TTY, `NO_COLOR`, 80-column limits, full-value preservation, and read-command rendering.

**Modified**
- `src/cli/commands/read-model.ts` — re-exports the shared formatting primitives; `NAME`/`PORT` no longer shrink; `REF`/`IMAGE` are droppable; `ReadOutputStream` exposes optional `isTTY`.
- `src/cli/commands/list.ts` — builds a formatter from stdout/environment, paints only the `STATUS` cell, keeps the text label.
- `src/cli/commands/status.ts` — renders fields through the formatter and paints `status`/`health` labels.
- `src/cli/commands/config.ts` — renders the summary through the formatter; `valid` stays a text label.
- `tests/unit/read-commands.test.ts` — added command-level proof that `runListCommand` colours only a TTY without `NO_COLOR`, and stays plain for `NO_COLOR` or a pipe.

## Requirements satisfied

- `OBS-FR-02` — TTY/`NO_COLOR` detection, no ANSI when colour is unavailable, tables within 80 columns, long values moved to detail lines.
- `PRD-ACC-01` — status is always a text label; colour is additive decoration only.
- `PRD-ACC-02` — non-TTY, `NO_COLOR`, and `TERM=dumb` emit no ANSI escapes.
- `PRD-ACC-03` — every rendered line fits 80 columns.
- `PRD` 12.2 table shape preserved, with `--json` output untouched.

## Validation

| Command | Result |
|---|---|
| `npm run typecheck` | pass |
| `npm run lint` | pass (69 files) |
| `npm test -- tests/unit/format.test.ts` | 19/19 pass |
| `npm test -- tests/unit/read-commands.test.ts` | 29/29 pass |
| `npm test` | 25 files, 623/623 pass |
| `npm run build` | pass |
| Manual `--help`, `version`, `version --json` | pass |
| Manual `doctor --json` | valid schemaVersion 1 JSON, no ANSI; exit 2 because this host lacks Railpack/BuildKit |
| Manual `list` under a PTY / with `NO_COLOR` / piped / `--json` | ANSI only on the TTY; labels intact; plain otherwise; JSON clean |

## Contract notes

- No command, flag, exit-code, JSON field, config key, or file-mode change.
- Internal API: `formatField`’s third positional `indent` became an options object, and `TableColumn` gained optional `droppable`/`paint`; the old names remain exported from `read-model.ts`, and all in-repo callers are updated.

handoff.summary: Implemented src/cli/format.ts with TTY/NO_COLOR colour decisions, text status labels, 80-column tables, column shrinking/dropping, and full-value detail lines; routed list, status, and config through it. Added 19 format tests plus command-level TTY/NO_COLOR coverage. Typecheck, lint, focused tests, the 623-test suite, build, and manual PTY/plain/JSON checks pass.
decisions: Colour is enabled only when NO_COLOR is absent, TERM is not dumb, and the output stream reports isTTY; status meaning always comes from the text label.

Tables shrink optional REF/IMAGE columns first, then drop them and print full values on detail lines; NAME and PORT never shrink below their content, and any value that must be clipped also appears in full on a labelled detail line.
Read commands build the formatter from their injected stdout and environment, so tests force TTY, pipe, and NO_COLOR without process globals.
Doctor output was left uncoloured; it already uses text labels and meets PRD-ACC-02 without adding colour.
interfaces: detectColor, noColorRequested, displayWidth, stripAnsi, wrapText, formatField, formatTable, OUTPUT_WIDTH, TableColumn, TableRow
formatListReport(rows, formatter?), formatStatusReport(rows, formatter?), formatConfigReport(record, spec, formatter?)
tests: manual PTY list: ANSI around status label; NO_COLOR/pipe: no ANSI; list --json: no ANSI
warnings: doctor --json exits 2 on this host because Railpack and BuildKit are absent; the JSON document itself is valid schemaVersion 1 and free of ANSI.
`formatField`'s third positional argument changed from a number to an options object; no documented CLI surface changed.
validationLimitations: Real TTY behaviour was exercised through the built CLI under `script` and through an injected isTTY recorder, not an interactive human terminal; screen-reader behaviour was reasoned from text-only output, not tested with assistive software.
